item.title: Bella Kay Explains Why Noah Kahan’s Success ‘Means Everything’ to Her
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update! We're talking about the rise of Bella Kay, the talented singer-songwriter who's been making waves on the Billboard Hot 100. Her single 'iloveitiloveitiloveit' burst onto the scene at the top of 2026, and since then, she's released her debut album 'My Reckless Abandon' and landed some major live bookings."
[Music transitions to a clip of "iloveitiloveitiloveit"]
Host: "Bella's success has also led to some exciting collaborations, including opening for Noah Kahan on his stadium tour in November. We caught up with her recently, and she reflected on Kahan's success, saying 'I think it means everything... he deserves it, for sure.' She also praised his authenticity, saying it's 'really scary to be an artist and put yourself out there on the line like that'."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Bella's own music is just as authentic, tackling topics like racial identity, struggles with food, and modern teenage romance on her debut album. She explained, 'It was really important to me on the album to not just talk about love or hate, but to explore the complexities of life.' Her goal is to create music that resonates with her fans, saying 'I think, when I was growing up, I would have loved to know that somebody else felt like I was feeling'."
[Music transitions to a clip of Bella Kay talking]
Host: "Bella's 'iloveitiloveitiloveit' peaked at number 17 on the Hot 100, and she's got even more exciting shows lined up, including a run of arena shows with Gracie Abrams in 2027. To learn more about Bella Kay and her rise to fame, check out the latest issue of Billboard, featuring her on the cover alongside Slayyyter and Trueno."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
